ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; primary surface area consists of low-intensity (black) pixels with a sparse distribution of high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing <3% total visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous field across both lobes. High-contrast white geometric blobs identified at the distal tip of the left lobe and as isolated punctate spots (diameter 2-10 pixels) distributed predominantly across the right lobe ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 35-40 degrees at the aperture, transitioning into a vertical linear fissure at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Non-linear trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitude variations. Left lobe features three distinct macro-indentations (approx. 15-40 pixel depth). Right lobe displays higher frequency, lower amplitude serrations along its continuous boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward to terminal distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Primary high-density constellation of circular high-contrast pixel groupings (barnacles) localized at the extreme tip of the left lobe. Secondary sparse distribution of individual high-contrast points scattered on the right lobe mid-section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical low-contrast linear disruptions detected on the proximal region of the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular mass of high-intensity pixels (barnacle colonization) on the left lobe terminal tip; prominent non-symmetrical indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical distribution of high-intensity punctate spots, with significantly higher density on the right lobe compared to the left lobe.
